'''Vercupti of sgazza boleruueé''' was an unidentifiable dish served in the [[Jedi Temple Main House]], a dining estabishment located at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was this dish that drove [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to try [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], as Obi-Wan preferred less exotic [[Foodstuff/Legends|meals]].<ref name="AOTC:TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The dish appears in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' under an alternate spelling, "vercupti of agazza boleruuee." This could be a typing error as the S key is beside the A key on a computer keyboard.

It appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[CZ-198]] on a menu.
